name: Burrow Channel
description: Connect to a Burrow deployment as a federated agent runtime

accounts.description: Named agent connections. Each key is an accountId (e.g. 'higgins', 'beacon').

token.description: Runtime token REFERENCE. "file:<absolute path>" reads a regular file owned by the gateway user with mode 0600 or 0400. "keychain:<item>" reads the macOS login keychain item (account <item>, service tokenKeychainService) via /usr/bin/security; macOS only. Any other value is a literal token: still accepted, but deprecated and warned about once.

tokenKeychainService.description: Keychain service name for a "keychain:<item>" token ref. Required with keychain refs; ignored otherwise.

autoJoinSpaces.description: Space IDs to automatically join on connect

useMcpTools.description: Skip the channel-era `suite_*` tool-name hints in agent prompts and emit MCP-compatible guidance instead. Enable this once the agent is wired to Burrow's /mcp endpoint for tool execution (ADR 0034).
